remarks: Discover exceptional Palm Springs living in the highly sought-after gated community of Waverly Park! Enjoy true resort living and effortless indoor-outdoor entertaining in this beautifully updated condo. Enter from private front courtyard with electronic gate and convenient street access. Soaring vaulted ceilings and a dramatic floor-to-ceiling stacked-stone fireplace anchor the living and dining areas, opening to a serene private patio with slatted pergola, cooling misters and soothing fountain.
